questions.stem: A circle in the xy-plane has its center at −1, 1. Line t is tangent to this circle at the point 5, −4. Which of the following points also lies on line t? 6
A circle has radius 4. A radius is drawn to the point where a tangent touches the circle. What is the angle between the radius and the tangent?
questions.explanation: A is correct. A radius to a point of tangency is perpendicular to the tangent.

questions.stem: Two tangent segments are drawn from the same external point to a circle. If one tangent segment has length 6, what is the length of the other?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Tangent segments from the same external point are congruent.

questions.stem: Two chords intersect inside a circle. One chord is divided into segments of lengths 4 and 5; the other into lengths 3 and x. What is x?
questions.explanation: C is correct. The intersecting-chords theorem gives a·b=c·x.
